evals.prompt: I'm building a SvelteKit app with shadcn-svelte (nova style, lucide icons). Create a settings form component with fields for: full name, email address, and notification preferences (email, SMS, push notifications as toggle options). Add validation states for required fields.
evals.expected_output: A Svelte component using Field.FieldGroup, Field.Field, ToggleGroup, data-invalid/aria-invalid validation, gap-* spacing, and semantic colors.
expectations: Uses Field.FieldGroup and Field.Field for form layout instead of raw div with space-y
Uses Switch for independent on/off notification toggles (not looping Button with manual active state)
Uses data-invalid on Field and aria-invalid on the input control for validation states
Uses gap-* (e.g. gap-4, gap-6) instead of space-y-* or space-x-* for spacing
Uses semantic color tokens (e.g. bg-background, text-muted-foreground, text-destructive) instead of raw colors like bg-red-500
No manual dark: color overrides

evals.prompt: Create a dialog component for editing a user profile. It should have the user's avatar at the top, input fields for name and bio, and Save/Cancel buttons with appropriate icons. Using shadcn-svelte with tabler icons.
evals.expected_output: A Svelte component with Dialog.Title, Avatar with Avatar.Fallback, data-icon on icon buttons, no icon sizing classes, @tabler/icons-svelte imports.
expectations: Includes Dialog.Title for accessibility (visible or with sr-only class)
Avatar includes Avatar.Fallback
Icons on buttons use the data-icon attribute (data-icon="inline-start" or data-icon="inline-end")
No sizing classes on icons inside components (no size-4, w-4, h-4, etc.)
Uses tabler icons (@tabler/icons-svelte) instead of @lucide/svelte when tabler is configured
Uses shadcn-svelte Dialog patterns (e.g. Dialog.Trigger wrapping the control, or bind:open on Dialog.Root)

evals.prompt: Create a dashboard component that shows 4 stat cards in a grid. Each card has a title, large number, percentage change badge, and a loading skeleton state. Using shadcn-svelte with lucide icons.
evals.expected_output: A Svelte component with full Card composition, Skeleton for loading, Badge for changes, semantic colors, gap-* spacing.
expectations: Uses full Card composition with Card.Header, Card.Title, Card.Content (not dumping everything into Card.Content)
Uses Skeleton component for loading placeholders instead of custom animate-pulse divs
Uses Badge component for percentage change instead of custom styled spans
Uses semantic color tokens instead of raw color values like bg-green-500 or text-red-600
Uses gap-* instead of space-y-* or space-x-* for spacing
Uses size-* when width and height are equal instead of separate w-* h-*

evals.prompt: Build me a SvelteKit design system using the shadcn-svelte preset from this folder. Use DESIGN.md: white canvas, #0075DE primary, 8px buttons, 12px cards, multi-layer soft shadows, 2px blue focus outline with 2px offset.
evals.expected_output: A SvelteKit app with all components installed, DESIGN.md tokens mapped onto the existing global CSS, and a complete design system page.
expectations: Scaffolds with sv create separately, then passes the supplied shadcn-svelte preset unchanged to init --preset; does not use React scaffolding flags
Installs all components with add --all --yes and counts component directories with index.ts barrels from disk
Reads DESIGN.md frontmatter, Do's and Don'ts and Known Gaps before editing
Maps colors into components.json tailwind.css and registers extra tokens in @theme inline
Pins the radius scale and documented multi-layer shadow scale
Implements the 2px focus outline and offset, including the pinned focus preview selector
Changes field control heights together with button height, inspecting tv variants and style CSS
Uses Svelte 5 snippets for state matrices and data-preview for hover, focus and active
Measures live contrast in an SSR-safe helper and renders do/dont pairs
Runs showcase-coverage.mjs for folder/barrel imports and verifies each installed component renders
Runs svelte-check and a production build; checks console errors, initial scroll and overflow in a browser

evals.prompt: Create a Svelte + Vite design system app called editorial using the supplied shadcn-svelte preset and DESIGN.md: cream #faf9f5 canvas, coral #cc785c primary that darkens only on press, licensed serif display (substitute Cormorant Garamond), Inter body, dark #181715 product surfaces, 40px buttons and inputs.
evals.expected_output: A Svelte + Vite app with font substitutes, type utilities, active-only primary styling, aligned controls, scoped dark bands, and a full showcase.
expectations: Scaffolds a svelte-ts Vite app separately and follows the shadcn-svelte Vite installation guide
Installs the specified font substitutes and imports every referenced face
Defines type-* utilities with serif family, documented weights and tracking
Uses active: instead of hover: for primary darkening
Raises related button and input control heights to 40px
Uses class="dark" for scoped dark surfaces and remeasures their contrast
Uses Svelte component barrels, child snippets and bind:value instead of React APIs
Reports font substitutions, retained hover states and derived dark values

evals.prompt: Create a new shadcn-svelte design system from DESIGN.md without a preset: editorial cream canvas, coral primary, 40px controls, 12px cards, 16px hero container, pill badges, rare shadows, 32px card padding.
evals.expected_output: A new SvelteKit app initialized with a suitable style, themed from DESIGN.md, and a full design system page.
expectations: Picks a style based on geometry and explains the reason, using init prompts or a builder-generated Svelte preset
Does not invent a preset code or pass bare style names or React preset codes to --preset
Uses components.json for aliases, style, icons and tailwind.css instead of info --json
Builds foundations, component examples and state matrices, edge cases, do/dont pairs and recipes
Reports all body-text contrast pairs below 4.5:1, including pairs specified by DESIGN.md
Keeps DOM helpers browser-only and verifies SvelteKit SSR plus dark mode
